description: Brooding and dark, Legato Bluesummers is a man with a vital plan: to ensure that Vash the Stampede suffered the worst mental and emotional anguish he could bear. With his company of villains, Legato formulates a cruel plan that tests the Humanoid Typhoon's mettle and morals. Cruel at every twist and turn, Legato pushes Vash towards his limits in order to inflict him painful reminders about the fact that not everyone shares the same peaceful philosophy he does. At the end of it all, Legato goes so far as to put his own life in danger to torment Vash even more...
summon: I intend to obliterate every last trace of mankind eventually, so why must you rush the inevitable?
fusion: Your very existence seems to cause me a measure of irritation, Vash the Stampede.
evolution: Now you know how painful it is to live.
